rachats.citation: 85 Comcast 2021 Annual Report on Form 10-K Table of Contents Comcast Corporation Acquisitions In October 2021, we acquired Masergy, a provider of software-defined networking and cloud platforms for global enterprises, for total cash consideration of $ 1.2 billion.

Acquisition of Sky Limited - Refer to Note 8 to the financial statements Critical Audit Matter Description The Company obtained a controlling interest in Sky Limited (“Sky”) for $39.4 billion on October 9, 2018 and finalized the purchase price allocation in 2019.
